$comment: RFC 0266 §A — the v2 alias inventory, beside the frozen spec/v1/alias-detectors.json (RFC 0167 §E). Same shape and meaning: each detector names a literal token that, while present in the named file, proves an alias is still in the corpus, and the deprecation row (spec/v1/ or spec/v2/deprecations.json, merged by id) that must cover it. scripts/check-alias-coverage.mjs reads both files. A detector for a row born in v2 lives here, because the v1 file is not edited (RFC 0234 §A.3).

detectors.alias: registry discovery flat v1-era endpoints keys
